description: The browser viewer for Machinome models: an embeddable three.js widget, portable exports, a development server and headless snapshots.
rules: machinome-viewer 0.7.0 releases with Machinome 0.7.0 and is numbered with it. It declares viewer API 26 and reads document versions 1-13; new running exports declare version 11 (source-timed motion), 12 when they carry a Follow relation between two moving surfaces, or 13 when a running bound reads finite convex-profile contact, and an older viewer refuses them.
Install it with the framework: pip install "machinome[viewer]". The widget is not published on npm; it ships inside the Python distribution. The Python package needs Python 3.11+.
Embed an exported page in an iframe, or load machinome-viewer.js and call MachinomeViewer.mount(target, documentUrl, options). mountInspector() adds a collapsible assembly sidebar.
The process interface is machinome-viewer describe|serve|capture (also python -m machinome_viewer). The machinome.viewer entry point provides only the bundle lookup.
The viewer and the framework never import each other; serving and capture run as separate processes.
The package and its browser bundle are AGPL-3.0-only; the Machinome framework is Apache-2.0.
